summary: Groundwork Effect policy pack research complete: 38 rules (35 ast-grep + 3 Quartz type-fitness) with passing fixture harness.

what_works: AST-only matchers catch idiomatic Effect misuse (yield vs yield*, missing catch, sync decode, unbounded queues, etc.)
Quartz type analysis catches broken Effect instantiations with any/unknown in error/requirement channels
Test harness unifies ast-grep and Quartz assertions against annotated fixtures
Policy files are valid Groundwork TOML and merge into a single pack
next_steps: Promote research pack to a real Groundwork plugin pack (groundwork-effect) installable via plugins = ["groundwork-effect"]
Add more Quartz rules: unknown error channel, never error channel on failable bodies, Effect<A,E,R> assignability leaks across module boundaries
Extend Quartz coverage from exported variables to function return types, parameters, and inline expression positions
Wire type-fitness checks as a Groundwork command matcher once the runtime supports command-type content
Run the pack against real Effect codebases (ether, quartz, prism-plugins) and tune false positives
Add CI step that runs `npm test` in groundwork/research-effect on every change
blockers: Groundwork policy schema currently only supports ast_grep and semgrep content; quartz rules are enforced by the research harness, not by Groundwork itself. A command/content matcher or harness hook is needed for production use.
